_comment: Visual models, animation maps and held-item visuals. Swapping a model is an edit here (and in appearance.json); no code changes. 'scene' is a client res:// path to a glTF/GLB ("" = placeholder shape only); a model that fails to load also falls back to its placeholder. scale multiplies the entity's own scale; nameplate_height and collision_radius are metres at entity scale 1 (the server uses collision_radius for mob melee reach). yaw_offset_deg turns the model to face the client's forward (-Z); +Z-facing glTF packs use 180. tints: material name (or '*') -> colour. parts: groups of alternative mesh nodes, default_parts picks one per group ("" = none). attachments: slot -> skeleton bone plus an optional offset. See docs/MODELS.md.

animation_maps._comment: Emberfall Basic humanoid rig (tools/gen_models.py). ground_speed is the speed (m/s) at which the clip's feet match the ground at 1x playback.
Emberfall Basic quadruped rig. No cast, sit or second attack: those fall back (cast -> idle, sit -> idle, attack2 -> attack1).

Polyfork characters (CC BY 4.0; 22-bone Mixamo-named rig, vertex colours) carrying the CC0 Quaternius Universal Animation Library clips, retargeted by tools/retarget_to_glb.sh with tools/retarget/polyfork_humanoid.json. Ground speeds are for the human warrior; each polyfork_* model sets 'stride' (its walk speed over the human warrior's, measured with tools/godot_convert/measure.gd). The models are dressed by their own outfit (class_style false); their own weapons are hidden (part group 'held') so equipment shows instead, and a helmet (part group 'helm') shows only while a head item is worn.
